Testing the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE signal (buying the same directional signal at 1DTE and 2DTE weekly options instead of 0DTE) on the period 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2. We expect to see improved expectancy due to lower theta decay in longer DTE options, while maintaining the same directional edge.
